text: Northumberland Street, stretching between Ossington Avenue and Westmoreland Avenue, is a high-traffic route connecting residents to many small businesses, schools, and Ossington Station. Despite its importance as a heavily travelled route, Northumberland Street remains one of the few streets in the area without traffic calming measures. I have heard from residents who shared concerns about speeding along Northumberland Street, highlighting a significant safety issue for pedestrians, cyclists, and drivers. In response to these issues, my office conducted a neighbourhood survey that confirmed strong community support for installing speed humps. Implementing these traffic calming measures will help reduce vehicle speeds and improve road safety for all who use Northumberland Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Northumberland Street, between Westmoreland Avenue and Concord Avenue, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 2, 2026) from Councillor Alejandra Bravo.
